sampling: One fixed draw; same initial-state and action distributions as the original experiment. 128 paired episodes per damping: 64 passive, 64 driven. No rejection sampling or seed search.
primary_split: splits/test: exclude the union, across both new damping variants, of episodes whose initial LeWM 13-frame or LeHami 14-frame image-plus-action training-length payload exactly matches any old development window in either damping dataset.

secondary_splits.test_all: All 128 fresh draws; preserves original distribution. Report overlap counts.
secondary_splits.test_strict_context: Primary set additionally excluding 4/5-frame initial visual-context matches; paired IDs across damping.

overlap_check_scope.old_pool: First 81 frames of old train/val episodes; all 325 frames of previously inspected old test episodes, from both damping files. All contiguous windows in this pool (a conservative superset of actual training starts).
overlap_check_scope.checks: Exact float64 initial states, full physical-state/float32-action trajectories, initial 4/5 RGB frames, initial 13/14 RGB-plus-action training-length payloads. SHA256 indexes with witnesses.
overlap_check_scope.limits: No near-duplicate guarantee; no claim that every future RGB window is absent from old data. Similar states and shared rendered equilibrium frames are expected in low-dimensional deterministic physics. Deduplicated subsets are filtered distributions, not the raw sampling distribution.
overlap_check_scope.distribution_audit: Save mode counts and initial |theta|, |omega|, and energy quantiles before and after filtering.

frozen_inference_contract.cohort: All 12 original validation-selected best.pt files; no re-selection
frozen_inference_contract.readouts: Use original saved ridge AND mlp readouts; no refitting, no new normalization statistics, no selection by new-test scores.
frozen_inference_contract.model_mode: eval(); disable parameter gradients; retain internal state derivatives needed by Hamiltonian flow; verify hashes before/after
frozen_inference_contract.authorized_inputs: Exactly first five real RGB frames at raw indices 0..4 (LeHami internally uses 1..4), historical controls 0..3, and exogenous future controls 4..323. Anchor raw frame 4; 320 autonomous steps (32 s).
frozen_inference_contract.forbidden_inputs: Future RGB and all physical-state labels must be kept outside the model input path. No teacher forcing, state corrections, re-encoding, or parameter updates.
frozen_inference_contract.evaluation_entry: Do not use dpbench.evaluate.evaluate directly: it binds the old dataset and refits readouts. A separate frozen-only evaluator must preserve original training provenance and separately verify the new-test SHA256.

scoring: No model scoring during creation. Future evaluation should report both fixed probes, all 3 seeds, passive/driven separately, with the original absolute angle/omega/energy metrics and horizons. Any additional metric must be labeled separately.
reuse_policy: Any tuning based on this holdout makes it development data; obtain another independent test set for subsequent final claims.
